item.name: Inventory
item.description:
Enterprise Inventory Management & Stock Ledger API.
Includes multi-warehouse stock management, atomic reservation engine, immutable movement audit ledger, and public stock availability.

request.description: Public endpoint masking raw counts for competitive privacy. Returns UX-friendly availability badges (isInStock, isLowStock, allowBackorder).
List multi-warehouse stock counts with onHand, reserved, backordered, safetyStock, and computed available.

exec: pm.test('Captures first inventory and variant IDs', function () {

request.description: Retrieves single warehouse inventory record with stock quantities and threshold configurations.

exec: var expected = Math.max(0, json.data.onHand - json.data.reserved - json.data.safetyStock);

request.description: Atomically mutates inventory physical onHand count and logs an immutable entry in the Stock Movement audit ledger within a MongoDB transaction.
Updates safetyStock, reorderThreshold, and allowBackorder flag using Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC).
Queries the immutable append-only stock movement ledger. Movement records can never be updated or deleted.
Fetches individual stock movement record by ID with actor, timestamp, quantity, and delta details.
Atomically reserves stock across warehouses with all-or-nothing rollback semantics. Sets 15-minute TTL.
Fetches active reservation and checks expiration timer.
Releases reserved physical units back to available stock when checkout expires or user abandons purchase.
Permanently commits stock onHand and reserved counts upon successful order payment.

item.name: Cart
item.description:
Enterprise Cart Module API.
Supports anonymous guest session cookies (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax), authenticated persistent carts, soft inventory availability tagging, price snapshot integrity, mutation idempotency, and atomic guest cart merging with stock issue reporting.

header.description: Optional: If provided, retrieves user's persistent cart. If omitted, uses/sets HttpOnly guest session cookie.

request.description: Retrieves current active cart. GET does NOT extend guest inactivity TTL. Never leaks sessionId in the response payload. Authenticated carts have expiresAt: null.

Transitions guest cart to MERGED and clears session cookie.

item.name: 8. Checkout Module
item.description: Enterprise checkout transaction lifecycle: cart locking, multi-currency pricing, address recalculation, physical inventory holds, and payment webhooks.

request.description: Initiates a checkout session. Validates published catalog items and price drift against cart snapshot. In a single atomic MongoDB transaction, locks the cart, reserves physical stock in inventory, and creates an authoritative temporary checkout snapshot with a 15-minute TTL.
